_comment: Plants a layer can be placed under. When a layer is generated where one of these plants stands, the plant is moved up one block onto the layer instead of blocking it. Add modded plants by block id.
_comment_grass: minecraft:grass is the name short_grass had before 1.20.3; this entry covers both.
_comment_old_format: A file written by an older version holds a "mappings" object instead of this list. It still works: its keys are read as the plant list.
